verdict.rationale: Paxos is a hosted, regulated stablecoin and crypto infrastructure API platform. A buyer comparing infrastructure platforms could fairly ask about self-hosting, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable or on-prem deployment of the core platform. The Sandbox is a Paxos-hosted test environment, and USDG's use in open-source smart contracts concerns a token building block, not running Paxos itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
